title: A novel method for extraction of a proteinous coagulant from Plantago ovata seeds for water treatment purposes
author: Ramavandi, Hashemi, et al.

steps.title: Gather required reagents
steps.instruction: Collect all chemicals and materials: dry Plantago ovata seeds, ammonium acetate, sodium hydroxide, hydrochloric acid, ferric chloride, calcium chloride, ethanol (98 %), CM‑Sepharose, distilled water, and a 0.42 µm membrane filter.

steps.title: Soak seeds in water
steps.instruction: Place the dry Plantago ovata seeds in distilled water and let them soak for 1 day.

steps.title: Filter, dry, and mill seeds
steps.instruction: Pass the gelatinous material obtained after soaking through a 0.42 µm membrane filter, dry the filtrate at 70 °C in an oven, then mill the dried material in a domestic blender (VARING).

substeps.instruction: Mill the dried material in a domestic blender.

steps.title: Defat powder with ethanol
steps.instruction: Mix the milled powder with ethanol (98 %) using a magnetic stirrer and stir for 60 min.

substeps.instruction: Stir with magnetic stirrer for 60 min.

steps.title: Dry oil‑free powder
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture at 3500 rpm for 40 min, discard the supernatant, and dry the settled powder overnight in an oven at 60 °C.

steps.title: Extract crude coagulant
steps.instruction: Add 10‑mM ammonium acetate to the oil‑free powder at 5 % w/w, then stir with a magnetic stirrer for 50 min.

substeps.instruction: Add 10‑mM ammonium acetate (5 % w/w of powder).
Stir for 50 min with magnetic stirrer.

steps.title: Separate crude extract
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the extraction mixture at 3500 rpm for 40 min and collect the supernatant as the crude extract.

steps.title: Equilibrate CM‑Sepharose resin
steps.instruction: Equilibrate CM‑Sepharose ion‑exchange resin with a 10‑mM ammonium acetate solution.

steps.title: Bind coagulant to resin
steps.instruction: Add the equilibrated CM‑Sepharose to the crude extract at 10 % (v/v) and mix with a blade stirrer for 50 min.

substeps.instruction: Stir with blade stirrer for 50 min.

steps.title: Elute protein with FeCl₃
steps.instruction: Elute the bound coagulant protein sequentially with 0.025 M FeCl₃ and then 0.05 M FeCl₃, repeating each elution three times.

substeps.instruction: First elution: add 0.025 M FeCl₃, collect eluate; repeat three times.
Second elution: add 0.05 M FeCl₃, collect eluate; repeat three times.

steps.title: Rinse purified coagulant
steps.instruction: Rinse the pooled eluate repeatedly with double‑distilled water until ferric ions are no longer detectable in the rinse water.

substeps.instruction: Wash coagulant with double‑distilled water multiple times.
Test rinse water for Fe ions; continue until none are detected.
